notes: Hosts that serve open, legal copies. jobs.mjs check accepts a URL whose host (or a parent) is listed in allow, or is already used by an item in corpus.json. An agent adding a new open host adds it here with a one-line reason. deny lists shadow libraries: never use them, whatever they hold.

allow.archive.org: Internet Archive: public-domain scans, the Wayback Machine (base list of server/cache.mjs)
allow.web.archive.org: Wayback Machine snapshots of open pages
allow.arxiv.org: arXiv preprints, free to read (base list)
allow.openlibrary.org: Open Library records and borrowable-free public-domain scans (base list; never its lending copies)
allow.cdn.jsdelivr.net: pdf.js and other open code (base list)
allow.lesswrong.com: LessWrong posts, free to read (base list)
allow.alignmentforum.org: Alignment Forum posts, free to read (base list)
allow.forum.effectivealtruism.org: EA Forum posts, free to read (base list)
allow.openreview.net: OpenReview: conference papers and reviews, open access
allow.jmlr.org: Journal of Machine Learning Research, open access
allow.transformer-circuits.pub: Anthropic interpretability papers, free to read
allow.openai.com: OpenAI research pages, free to read
allow.anthropic.com: Anthropic research pages, free to read
allow.deepmind.google: Google DeepMind research pages and blog, free to read
allow.storage.googleapis.com: Google DeepMind PDFs, free to read
allow.epoch.ai: Epoch AI reports, free to read
allow.redwoodresearch.substack.com: Redwood Research blog, free to read
allow.forecastingresearch.org: Forecasting Research Institute reports, free to read
allow.goodjudgment.com: Good Judgment articles, free to read
allow.metaculus.com: Metaculus notebooks and essays, free to read
allow.escholarship.org: University of California eScholarship, open access
allow.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov: PubMed Central open-access full text (pmc/ only)
allow.plato.stanford.edu: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, free to read
allow.substack.com: Substack posts that are free to read (never paywalled ones)
allow.github.io: Authors' own pages on GitHub Pages
allow.github.com: Open code and papers hosted by their authors
